snippet.title: Summer Sisters - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
It's been years since Yuu last visited the countryside, and this summer, he'll finally be reunited with the sisters Hana, Rina, and Hina! Unfortunately, his mom has to hurry home, so he'll be staying with the three of them for a while. Find out what fun awaits him in Japanese countryside!
